title: Phase 9 / E14: Independent Reproduction Audit & Clean Checkout Verification Protocol
primary_question: Can the entire GLHS R3 experimental campaign (all 15 experiments E00 through E14), cryptographic artifact seals, statistical estimand bounds, and manuscript tables be deterministically reproduced in a hermetic clean environment without manual intervention?
unit_of_analysis: One end-to-end execution of the reproduction audit harness over a clean repository clone.

primary_endpoints.name: Clean Checkout Claim Reproduction Rate
primary_endpoints.definition: 1.0 if 100% of claim-bearing experimental results reproduce from raw artifacts on a fresh checkout, 0.0 otherwise.

secondary_endpoints.name: Cryptographic Seal Verification Rate
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of prospective protocol SHA256 hashes matching sealed values.

statistical_plan.method: Hermetic Zero-Tolerance Cryptographic & Deterministic Reproduction Audit

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: Any hash mismatch, missing raw artifact, or unbacked manuscript claim halts final release.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Missing raw artifacts invalidate claim eligibility.
